thread:
maria g: Quick sync: planning to enable ff:batch_cache_v3 for a 10% prod canary at 10:30 PST today. Need ops + oncall eyes. TL;DR: expecting lower CPU and improved tail latency. Anyone object?
aj patel: What's the canary audience? only write-heavy endpoints? any model pinning?
lee chen: Plan: 10% global traffic, exclude routing-key 'search' for the first hour. Model pinned to redwood-1.2.3-quant. Flags: `ff_batch_cache_v3` = on, `ff_batch_cache_v3_audience` = 10, `ff_batch_cache_v3_exclude` = search. Rollout window 10:30-11:30 PST. I'll flip canary and monitor.
nisha r: KPIs to watch: p99 latency (compare vs baseline), 5xx rate, token throughput, cache_hit_rate, GPU util, and any `model.kv_miss.*` logs. Rollback criteria: p99 > baseline + 50ms for >5m OR sustained 5xx > 0.5% for 5m. Also rollback if cache_hit drops >20% vs baseline.
maria g: Can someone post quick Grafana panels and a smoke curl we can run? Also want alert hooks and a rollback runbook ready.
lee chen: Dashboards: https://grafana.internal/r/redwood/batch-cache (panel: Batch Cache health) I added a pinned view. Smoke curl to exercise KV-path:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"redwood-1.2.3","prompt":"hello"}'
```
Run with 50 concurrent reqs for 2m to simulate.
aj patel: :thumbsup: I'll create short alerts: p99 > baseline+30ms (warning), p99 > baseline+50ms (critical), 5xx > 0.5% (critical). Also adding an Ops guardrail: auto rollback if KV cache_hit drops >20% vs baseline for 3m.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: flag flip scheduled by lee chen at 1850001800. preflight checks passed.
ops-monitor: Metric snapshot before flip: p99=120ms, 5xx=0.03%, cache_hit=86%, gpu_util=62%. Saved snapshot id sn-1850001220.
lee chen: I'll flip at 10:32 and post logs. If anything looks off, I'll rollback and notify oncall.
maria g: If we hit rollback, steps: 1) set `ff_batch_cache_v3` = off, 2) unset audience/exclude, 3) open an incident if >30m. @nisha r you own postmortem?
nisha r: Yes. I'll also kick off perf regressions for top 20 routes and collect sample traces.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: flag `ff_batch_cache_v3` toggled ON for audience 10% by lee chen at 1850001950.
aj patel: Seeing initial telemetry: p99 118ms -> stable, GPU util up ~4%, cache_hit 88% :+1: 
ops-monitor: Canary window 0-15m: no 5xx spikes, no KV errors. Continuing to monitor.
maria g: Thanks all. Ping here once we hit 30m mark with green status.
